rows.note: Off and grayed out with Time Clock off; tooltip verbatim; Time Clock off through the Public API: NO SCREEN.
rows.prd_text: Technician can only be on while Time Clock is on. While Time Clock is off, the Technician toggle is off and grayed out, and hovering it shows "Turn on Time Clock first. Only staff who clock in can be technicians." Turning Time Clock off, in the window or any other way (for example through the Public API), turns Technician off.

rows.note: TT-D01: page 3 says turning Time Clock back on leaves Technician off (shown on New Staff Member, 'Edit behaves the same'); S1-R5 v17 pre-fills from the role in New Staff Member. Question 1.
rows.prd_text: In Edit Staff Member, turning Time Clock back on leaves Technician off; the user turns it on. In New Staff Member, turning Time Clock on pre-fills Technician from the role (S1-R3), unless the user has already switched Technician by hand.

rows.pictures: tt-p2-06 (on, not saved; list behind still No), tt-p2-07 (after save: Yes)
rows.note: The window's existing save is labelled 'Save & Close' (TT-D05, settled).
rows.prd_text: Switching Technician on or off changes nothing until the user saves the staff member with the window's existing Save. Once saved, the change applies to every technician list (Story 3) the next time each list loads (S1-E3).

rows.note: No warning on turning on (no warning is drawn between the two pictures).
rows.prd_text: A save that turns Technician on never shows a warning. A save that turns it off may show the Turn Off Technician warning first (Story 2).

rows.note: Never logs out: caption only.
rows.prd_text: Saving a change to Technician never logs the staff member out. A save that also changes Time Clock logs them out, as a Time Clock change does today.

rows.note: Billable stays No while Technician becomes Yes.
rows.prd_text: Billable and Sales Representative work exactly as today. Technician does not change, gray out or require either of them, and neither of them changes Technician.

rows.note: Office User role: off, grayed, tooltip verbatim. Time Clock User role: NOT SHOWN (TT-N03).
rows.prd_text: When the role picked in the window is the built-in Office User or Time Clock User role, the Technician toggle is off and grayed out, and hovering it shows "This role can't be a technician." Picking one of those roles turns Technician off. In Edit Staff Member, saving a staff member who was saved with Technician on and now has one of those roles shows the Turn Off Technician warning first (Story 2)

rows.note: Permission as today.
rows.prd_text: If the user does not have the 'Settings → App Settings' setting, they cannot open the staff list or the staff window, as today.

rows.note: No history.
rows.prd_text: This feature adds no history of who changed Technician or when.

rows.pictures: tt-p2-03 caption 'Edit Staff Member never does this.'
rows.note: Role change in Edit leaves Technician as it is: caption only.
rows.prd_text: In Edit Staff Member, changing the staff member's role to any role other than the built-in Office User or Time Clock User role leaves Technician as it is. Picking the built-in Technician or Foreman role does not turn it on; the pre-fill (S1-R3) is for new staff only.

rows.note: Deactivated staff member: not drawn.
rows.prd_text: A deactivated staff member keeps their Technician toggle as it was, but is not a technician while deactivated (Story 3). Reactivating them brings it back as it was.

rows.note: Open screens keep their lists: not drawn.
rows.prd_text: A screen that is already open when a staff member's Technician toggle is saved keeps its lists until it loads them again; nothing is pushed to open screens. A work order's technician dropdowns show the change once the work order is opened again or the page is reloaded; reopening a dropdown on the same page does not. Board View and Tech View show it when opened from the menu, a link or the display

rows.note: Deactivate Account with no warning (TT-N18).
rows.prd_text: Deactivate Account shows no Turn Off Technician warning. The person keeps their Technician toggle as it was (S1-E2), is not offered as a technician while deactivated, and keeps every work order and line they hold.

rows.prd_text: When at least one work order or line is counted, a warning window titled "Turn Off Technician" shows. The text names the staff member as last saved (a new name typed in the same save is not used) and what they hold, for example: "Jordan Lee leads 8 open work orders and is on 50 labor lines. They'll stay on them, but won't be offered as a technician on anything new."

rows.note: Single-count forms (TT-N04).

rows.prd_text: The window has Cancel and Save. Save continues the staff save as in S1-R6. Cancel, the X or Escape close the warning and leave the staff member unsaved, with the staff window still open and the toggle as the user left it; clicking outside the warning does nothing. rows.note: Nothing unassigned: caption only.
rows.prd_text: Saving with Technician off unassigns nothing. Every lead and labor line stays as it was (Story 3, S3-R7 and S3-R8).

rows.note: No warning without open work: caption only.
rows.prd_text: If no open work order or line is counted, no warning shows and the save goes straight on.
If the save does not turn Technician off (it was already off, or stays on), no warning shows.
Declined, Complete, Invoiced and Paid work orders, part sales, and declined lines on any work order are never counted.
A save that turns Technician off in more than one way at once (for example Technician and Time Clock both switched off, or Time Clock off and the Office User role picked) shows the warning once.

rows.note: TT-N06.
rows.prd_text: Turning off Sales Representative still shows its existing removal warning at the moment that toggle is switched off, as today; the Turn Off Technician warning shows only on Save. Cancelling the Turn Off Technician warning cancels the whole save, including a Sales Representative removal already confirmed, and the window stays open as the user left it.

A person who is not a technician can still press Start on an approved line and record time, as today; doing so adds them to the line's labor as today.

rows.prd_text: The staff list (Settings, Staff) gains a read-only "Technician" column directly left of Billable, on the Active and Deactivated tabs. Each row shows "Yes" (green) when the person is active, their Technician toggle is on and their Time Clock is on, otherwise "No" (red), in the same style as the Billable column. A deactivated person always shows "No", whatever their toggles.
